description: This file defines a workflow phase for showing the join command in Kubernetes kubeadm initialization, including template rendering for user instructions and functions to generate and display join commands for control-plane and worker nodes.

methods.name: showJoinCommand
methods.description: Prints the join command for control-plane and worker nodes after init phases are completed.

methods.name: printJoinCommand
methods.description: Generates and executes the template to display join commands for control-plane and worker nodes.
